question: How many players on each side are allowed on the field at a time in the game of Kabaddi?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 7.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The correct answer to the question is option 1, i.e., 7 players on each side are allowed on the field at a time in the game of Kabaddi.**
 
• **Kabaddi **is a contact sport that originated in ancient India and is **played between two teams of seven players each.**
 
• The objective of the game is for a player, **known as the raider, to enter the opposing team's half of the court, tag as many defenders as possible, and return to their own half without getting tackled by the defenders**.
 
• The defenders, on the other hand, **aim to stop the raider by tackling them before they can return to their own half**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer to the question is option 1, i.e., 7 players on each side are allowed on the field at a time in the game of Kabaddi.
